rdfs:label: alsoKnownAs
rdfs:comment: An alternate identifier for an ActivityStreams Object — typically a previous identity an Actor used before migrating servers, kept as a back-reference so old followers can find them.
notes: Standard fediverse-account-migration pattern: when an Actor moves servers, the *new* account lists the old one in `as:alsoKnownAs`, and the *old* account points at the new with `as:movedTo`. Together they make migration lossless — followers can verify the new identity is authorised by the old one.

examples.title: A migrated Actor pointing back at the old identity
